en.io: Input: spend line items, PO timing records, supplier clusters, industry profile, and user-assigned criticality. Output: categorized spend report, Pareto analysis, cycle scorecard, bottleneck flags, consolidation plan, estimated savings, and contingency warnings.
en.boundary: Uses a limited startup-oriented UNSPSC-aligned map, not the full taxonomy. It refuses to infer supplier criticality and treats outputs as inputs to human procurement decisions. Purchasing-cycle data is optional, and consolidation savings depend on supplied switching costs.
dependencies: JSON spend, PO, and supplier data
User-supplied tier-1/2/3 criticality and switching-cost judgments
scenarios: Identify duplicate suppliers and renewal clusters.

zh.io: 输入：支出明细、PO 时间记录、供应商集群、行业画像及用户指定的关键性。输出：分类支出报告、Pareto、周期记分卡、瓶颈标记、整合方案、节省估算和应急警告。
zh.boundary: 使用面向科技公司的有限 UNSPSC 对齐映射，并非完整分类库；不会推断供应商关键性，结果只作为人工采购决策的输入。周期数据可选，节省估算依赖所给切换成本。
dependencies: JSON 支出、PO 和供应商数据
用户提供的 tier-1/2/3 关键性及切换成本判断
scenarios: 审计年度 SaaS 支出。
找出采购流程缓慢的品类。
识别重复供应商和续约扎堆。
